---
title: "Data Dictionary"
---

## `policies.csv`

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `policy_id` | Unique policy identifier |
| `policyholder_id` | Unique policyholder identifier |
| `product` | Insurance product |
| `region` | Policy region |
| `driver_age` | Driver or insured age |
| `risk_score` | Simplified underwriting risk score |
| `exposure` | Earned exposure for the policy year |
| `earned_premium` | Earned premium amount |
| `policy_start` | Policy start date |

## `claims.csv`

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `claim_id` | Unique claim identifier |
| `policy_id` | Policy identifier used for joining |
| `claim_date` | Claim occurrence date |
| `claim_type` | Claim category |
| `claim_amount` | Incurred claim amount |
| `closed` | Whether the claim is closed |

## Known Teaching Features

The sample data is intentionally small. It includes varied risk scores, regions, claim types, and one claim linked to a policy so participants can practice validation and joins without spending the session on data engineering.
